important_note: Latanoprost is NOT available as an oral solid dosage form (tablet or capsule) in the United States. It is exclusively formulated as an ophthalmic solution for treatment of ocular hypertension and open-angle glaucoma. The database query for 'pill physical characteristics' does not apply to this medication.
